invariants.statement: Policy cannot self-ratify. Policy authority must be established exclusively via an external ratification certificate signed by a verified cryptographic quorum.
invariants.proof_requirement: The policy engine rejects any policy document that lacks an external ratification certificate matching its canonical SHA-256 hash with at least 3-of-4 bootstrap signatures.
invariants.negative_control: Supply GOVERNANCE_POLICY_V1 with an internal self-ratification claim but no external ratification certificate; evaluation must fail closed.
invariants.requalification_trigger: Any policy modification, key rotation, or quorum modification.

invariants.statement: There is exactly one authoritative ledger head per governance epoch. Silent forking or competing branches are strictly rejected.
invariants.proof_requirement: Every event extends the unique existing head hash. Any event specifying a parent that is not the current head produces a FORK_DETECTED fault.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt to append two conflicting events with sequence N+1 pointing to the same parent; engine must reject the second and halt.
invariants.requalification_trigger: Any ledger synchronization or recovery event.

invariants.statement: Historical ledger events are immutable. Historical event payloads and cryptographic hashes cannot be altered, reordered, or deleted.
invariants.proof_requirement: Re-evaluation of the entire event chain from sequence 0 to head must produce bit-for-bit hash parity across all events.
invariants.negative_control: Mutate one byte in event sequence 1 payload; chain verification must fail with EVENT_HASH_MISMATCH.

invariants.statement: The Finding Registry must remain strictly consistent with the Authority Ledger. The active finding state is a deterministic projection of ledger events.
invariants.proof_requirement: The computed finding_registry_hash must match the registry hash emitted in the latest FINDING_* ledger event.
invariants.negative_control: Inject an out-of-band finding directly into memory without a supporting ledger event; verification must fail with REGISTRY_LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.
invariants.requalification_trigger: Every finding update or decision generation.

invariants.statement: Evidence completeness is strictly required for READY. An internally consistent but selectively incomplete evidence set cannot drive READY.
invariants.proof_requirement: EVIDENCE_SET_COMPLETE must equal TRUE, and missing_required_evidence_refs must equal 0 before GLOBAL_PROVISIONING_READINESS can evaluate to READY.
invariants.negative_control: Omit one mandatory evidence item from the inventory while all findings are clean; decision must evaluate to BLOCKED.

invariants.statement: Every mandatory audit must emit either explicit findings or an authoritative ZERO_FINDING_ATTESTATION bound to audit ID, hash, and reviewer.
invariants.proof_requirement: Any mandatory audit lacking both recorded findings and an active zero-finding attestation fails evidence completeness.
invariants.negative_control: Register an audit completion without findings and without an attestation certificate; decision must fail closed.

invariants.statement: Stale decisions cannot authorize actions. A decision snapshot is valid only for its exact bound inputs; any change invalidates eligibility.
invariants.proof_requirement: If current ledger head, policy hash, registry hash, or evidence inventory differs from decision snapshot, decision_validity evaluates to STALE.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt to issue an authorization against a decision whose bound ledger head is older than current ledger head; must reject with DECISION_STALE.

invariants.statement: Decision does not equal authorization. A readiness decision of READY indicates eligibility only and does not confer execution or provisioning authority.
invariants.proof_requirement: Separate schemas, cryptographic signatures, and lifecycle states exist for decisions versus authorizations.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt to invoke a provisioning or execution runtime operation by supplying only a READY decision snapshot; must reject with AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED.

invariants.statement: Authorizations must explicitly bind the exact evaluated decision snapshot hash.
invariants.proof_requirement: An authorization without decision_hash or with a mismatched decision_hash is rejected by execution guardians.
invariants.negative_control: Submit an authorization with an arbitrary or mismatched decision_hash; execution must reject with INVALID_DECISION_BINDING.

invariants.statement: Authorizations must be strictly bound to explicit operator identity, allowed actions, and least-authority resource scopes.
invariants.proof_requirement: Operational entrypoint validates that actor identity matches, requested action is in allowed_actions, and target resources are within resource_scope.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt an action outside allowed_actions (e.g. ARM_NATURAL_OBSERVER on a PROVISIONING authorization); must reject with OUT_OF_SCOPE_ACTION.

invariants.statement: Authorizations are immediately invalidated by any authority-head change prior to execution (TOCTOU protection).
invariants.proof_requirement: Before an authorized operation executes, the guardian re-verifies that CURRENT_LEDGER_HEAD == AUTHORIZATION.ledger_head_hash.
invariants.negative_control: Append a new ledger event between authorization issuance and execution; execution must reject with TOCTOU_VALIDATION_FAILED.

invariants.statement: Finding ordering does not affect decision outcome. The decision engine is mathematically order-independent across all permutations of findings.
invariants.negative_control: Evaluate finding set in reverse order; resulting decision hash and gate statuses must be identical.
invariants.requalification_trigger: Every decision engine build or test suite execution.

invariants.statement: Adding blockers cannot improve readiness (monotonic safety property).
invariants.proof_requirement: Adding an active blocking finding, reopening a finding, or expiring a waiver can never transition readiness from BLOCKED to READY.
invariants.negative_control: Inject an additional critical finding into an already BLOCKED or READY state; readiness must never advance or improve.

invariants.statement: Governance rollback is strictly rejected. Restored governance state must prove sequence monotonicity and ancestry to prior witnessed head.
invariants.proof_requirement: Restored state with sequence < witnessed sequence or divergent hash chain fails closed with GOVERNANCE_ROLLBACK_DETECTED.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt to restore an older ledger state (sequence N-1) when sequence N has been witnessed; must fail closed.
invariants.requalification_trigger: Every recovery or state restore operation.

invariants.statement: Second governance genesis is strictly prohibited. Genesis sequence 0 occurs exactly once across the lifetime of the governance system.
invariants.proof_requirement: The genesis constructor checks external custody; if any prior epoch or genesis exists, creation fails closed.
invariants.negative_control: Call create_genesis() in an environment where an authoritative epoch already exists; must raise SECOND_GENESIS_PROHIBITED.

invariants.statement: Historical decision snapshots replay exactly. Given historical input hashes and engine version, recomputation yields identical decision payload and hash.
invariants.negative_control: Replay historical snapshot with altered policy or registry; replay must produce hash mismatch.

invariants.statement: Future infrastructure provisioning evidence must ingest directly into the same authoritative governance ledger and evidence inventory.
invariants.proof_requirement: Provisioning evidence emitted by operator scripts must be formatted as EVIDENCE_REGISTERED ledger events and evaluated by the same decision engine.
invariants.negative_control: Attempt to qualify Theorem A-D via an un-ingested sidecar report; gate evaluation must reject with MISSING_GOVERNANCE_EVIDENCE.

invariants.statement: Candidate 004 freeze manifest remains completely invariant across all governance control plane operations (Candidate 004 diff = 0).
invariants.proof_requirement: git diff against CANDIDATE_GENERATION_004_FREEZE.json is 0 bytes and hash matches 297ef5ab6399f57ef541d4413dc9e9fde15a143f8c1d18e1608173a4165f8e90.
invariants.negative_control: Modify any byte in Candidate 004 freeze files; pre-commit and test checks must immediately fail.
